definition: A type O visa is a non-immigrant visa for foreign workers who wish to remain in the United States to work temporarily. It is given to those who have extraordinary ability in the sciences, arts, education, business, or athletics, or extraordinary achievements in the motion picture and television field. The worker must have earned an internationally recognized award or have other qualifications such as commanding a high salary or providing significant contributions to their field. The US Citizenship and Immigration Services also recognizes subtypes of the O visa for individuals who assist a foreign worker with extraordinary ability (O-2) and for the spouse and children of the foreign worker (O-3).
